answer: Thread-Bound Onyx Claim. Each agent picks a unique cedar-seeded proof-of-work nonce; its hash must thread into every action it signs, so clones need fresh work per identity. Honest agents pay the work once and reuse the thread across all tasks. Attackers pay full compute per clone, with no reuse, making N sybils cost N full proofs while honest cost stays one proof amortized over many actions.
